subject.title: fix(secrets): resolve active exec refs locally

question: Should mixed command targets use split per-path resolution, or move the whole target set to local resolution whenever an active exec SecretRef exists?
rationale: Both proof-positive candidates fix the log flood but establish different permanent credential-execution and gateway-snapshot ownership boundaries.

options.title: Adopt split ownership
options.body: Use this PR's narrower per-path design after repairing unrecovered failure diagnostics.

options.title: Adopt whole-target local resolution
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96661 and resolve the entire mixed target set locally whenever an active exec ref exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt split ownership
recommendation.body: Use this PR's narrower per-path design after repairing unrecovered failure diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The foundational resolver history connects this adjacent owner to the cross-cutting command, gateway, and secret-execution policy decision.
